interpretation: the durable job journal holds: hash-chained replay returns records in order, torn tails and mid-file edits truncate honestly, and compaction rewrites only live state. Bound to the job store, terminal jobs come back as-was, in-flight jobs recover as failed with an honest restart error, idempotency keys still resolve, cancels and LRU evictions survive, and callback secrets never touch disk. The in-memory default is unchanged when no state dir is configured.
